title: The Reply of the Tongue Is from the LORD

reflections.title: "Commit your works to the LORD"

reflect.text: We often work hard to build our own plans and reach our goals. Yet striving for success only for ourselves brings spiritual exhaustion and leaves our hearts empty. True work needs both careful effort and steady reliance on God's guidance, for labor done without Him brings no lasting good or eternal honor.

Committing our work to the Lord means rolling our heavy burdens and tight ambitions over to Jesus. We bring our plans before Him in humble prayer and surrender our own way to His lordship. When we let go of our tight grip, God shapes our desires to match His own good and lasting path.

questions: What personal plans or heavy worries do you need to roll over to Jesus today?
How can you invite God into your daily work through humble prayer?
reflections.prayer: Lord Jesus, I place my work and my daily ambitions into Your hands. Please forgive me for striving in my own strength without seeking Your will. Teach me to trust You with all my heart and find true peace in Your direction. Amen.

D5.author: Alexandra Hoover
D5.work: Trusting God's Will Over Our Way

reflections.title: "The LORD determines his steps"

reflect.text: It is good to set goals and think ahead, but life often brings sudden changes and hardships that disrupt our expectations. When our schedules are interrupted, we can easily feel frustrated. Yet God remains in complete control of every twist and turn in our story.

Knowing God's loving character helps us meet every detour with grace. Even when the path He chooses includes trials, His presence stays near and His promises never fail. When we let go of rigid expectations, the Holy Spirit softens our stubborn ways and opens new doors for us to serve others.

questions: How do you usually react when an unexpected problem ruins your schedule for the day?
What opportunities to care for others might God be placing along your interrupted path?
reflections.prayer: Father, thank You that You direct my steps even when my plans fall apart. Help me to let go of my stubborn expectations and trust Your good purpose in every delay. Give me a willing heart to love and serve those You place in my way today. Amen.

D6.author: Kristine Brown
D6.work: A Prayer for When Things Don't Go as Planned

reflections.title: Resting in the Hand of the Sovereign God

reflect.text: Life can feel like a tangled wilderness full of dangers. We need true wisdom to guide our lives, and Scripture shows that "the true way to handle a matter wisely is to trust in the Lord," as Charles Spurgeon writes. Believing in God keeps our feet steady so that we do not waste our strength or stumble in the dark.

Our days do not happen by blind chance, for even the roll of a lot is decided by God. Remembering that our Father cares for every detail of life brings a quiet peace to our minds. It is our duty to obey Him with cheerful trust and leave all the providing to His mercy and boundless wisdom.

When our main desire is to please God in faith and obedience, He protects us and guards our peace. He can turn away the anger of those who oppose us or even soften their hearts into kindness. We can rest secure, knowing that our lives are safely kept in His hands.

questions: In what area of your life are you fretting about circumstances instead of trusting God's fatherly care?
How does knowing that God holds all outcomes bring you peace when facing difficult people or situations?
reflections.prayer: Almighty God, thank You for ruling over every detail of my life with perfect wisdom and tender love. Deliver me from anxious worry and teach me to focus on obeying You each day. Grant me faith to walk uprightly and rest in Your peaceful care. Amen.
